name: Seachem Flourish Excel
description: Liquid organic-carbon source (polycycloglutaracetal) — a CO2 alternative for low-tech tanks. Supplies bioavailable carbon, not a measurable water-chemistry ppm, so `contributes` is intentionally absent.
notes: Sensitive-plant caveat: overdosing (or any dose at all, for some) can melt Vallisneria, mosses, Anacharis, and harm some shrimp/invertebrates. Start well below the label dose.
